name: techassist-ai-helpdesk
displayName: TechAssist AI — Level 1 IT Helpdesk & Support Agent
description: Enterprise-grade Tier-1 IT Support Chatbot with sub-millisecond TF-IDF NLP inference, calibrated confidence threshold fallback, SQLite ticket management, and full ITIL v4 compliance.

tools.name: techassist_classify_intent
tools.description: Classifies an incoming IT support request using calibrated TF-IDF and Softmax probabilities (<1ms latency) with out-of-domain fallback detection.

query.description: The user query or issue description.

apply_spellcheck.description: Enable Levenshtein typo correction against canonical IT vocabulary.

tools.name: techassist_get_solution
tools.description: Retrieves step-by-step IT troubleshooting guidance and knowledge base procedures for a classified intent.

intent.description: Canonical intent identifier (e.g., redefinicao_senha, problema_vpn_acesso, lentidao_sistema).

tools.name: techassist_create_ticket
tools.description: Creates and escalates a formal Level-2 IT support ticket (#TK-XXXXX) persisted in relational SQLite database with full ITIL audit trail.

description.description: Detailed description of the hardware, network, or software incident.

tools.name: techassist_list_tickets
tools.description: Lists persisted IT tickets filtered by status (ABERTO, EM_ATENDIMENTO, RESOLVIDO) or priority.

tools.name: techassist_explain_prediction
tools.description: Explainable AI (XAI) feature attribution showing token TF-IDF weights and Softmax distribution.
